podcast.title: Musical Style of Space Monkeyz
podcast.body: Caribbean music is one of the styles, along with African music and Rige rhythms, that was explored and performed by Space Monkeyz, the group invented by Damon Albarn for their collaboration with Gorillaz. "música caribeña, africana y de ritmos Rige."
